verdict.rationale: A government immigration agency could plausibly publish a system-to-system channel with an enrollment path, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a failed TLS probe of the site's robots.txt, which says nothing about system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers, or a published enrollment path.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, a documented system-to-system channel exists for software to transact with the service (system accounts, transmitter programs, batch providers), with the enrollment path published
